items.title: How Seoul Institute of the Arts Students Use Suno | In The Cut
items.excerpt: Suno visits Seoul Institute of the Arts in South Korea to show how music students use Suno to sketch song ideas, experiment with vocals and harmonies, find chords, and separate stems in Suno Studio before continuing work in their existing DAW workflows.

items.title: Splice CEO Kakul Srivastava thinks AI emails are killing conversations
items.excerpt: Interview with Splice CEO Kakul Srivastava on how the sample platform has tried to carefully thread the line on AI music tools for producers.

items.title: AI 작곡·보컬 노래가 결국 음원차트 1위가 됐다 ①
items.excerpt: 창작자 머무르의 '꿈꾸던 어른이 되었나요?'는 수노(Suno)로 보컬을 생성하고 기획·작사·프로듀싱은 직접 맡은 곡으로, 멜론 등 음원차트 상위권에 오르며 AI 제작 음원 표기 의무 등 제도 논의를 다시 불러왔다. (Off-list exception: Korean-market coverage; no allowed-domain outlet covered it.)

items.title: “The death of Suno”: Reddit users have turned against Suno after v6 model update
items.excerpt: Suno's own power users on Reddit are revolting against the v6 model update, while labels say it hasn't satisfied them either: 'V6 is not a fresh start; it is the fruit of the same poisoned tree.'

items.title: Feds Want Nearly 4 Years in Prison for AI Music Fraudster Who 'Stole Millions'
items.excerpt: Prosecutors want convicted AI music fraudster Michael Smith, who used AI-generated songs and bot streams to collect about $8M in royalties, to get nearly four years in prison; he is asking for probation.

items.title: Suno is ‘far beyond’ 2m subscribers and $300m in revenue, says Mikey Shulman – who argues it’s ‘good’ that AI music has no ‘firm rules of the road’ yet
items.excerpt: Suno CEO Mikey Shulman says the v6-era service has passed 2M subscribers, sets out what WMG and BMG get from their licensing deals, and argues about who should set AI music's rules.

items.title: Spotify Editorial Playlists' Followers & Listeners Slip Amid Fake Account and AI Slop Crackdowns, Report Finds
items.excerpt: Listener counts on Spotify's biggest editorial playlists are slipping as the platform cracks down on fake accounts, streaming manipulation and AI-generated 'slop', according to a new report.
